summary: Reviewed w211's commits 8712f769 and 31436ec1 (they match the implementer's result). The features/ change is only the retirement of @r1/@r3 the work-item lists. No test was removed or weakened outside that retirement, and the report's allowances hold. tools size: clean. tools check: 6 ruff and 2 vulture issues in the new step modules (Minor). Three Important findings are fix now, all in work take-in: (1) a sent turn taken in on the upstream's turn ends the upstream's turn (it can set accepted, refused or awaiting-asker); (2) a sent request whose id is one the upstream already keeps, for example an internal request that is never published, overwrites it; (3) a sent title or answer text is spliced into the request's markdown, so an injected '## Outcomes' section reads as the upstream's line outcomes (r43, r34). Observations: a sent id used as a path, an allowed asker id writing on another asker's request, one bad item stopping every work run, publish failing after the commit, Thens that assert the test's own rendering, and D5's asker-side show not done. The fix-now findings are verified by reading the code; no repository probe could be run.
questions: Important, scripts/workqueue_takein.py:61 -> workqueue_request.py:234-246: a sent 'turn' taken in while the request is in the upstream's turn ends the upstream's turn for it (it can set accepted, refused or awaiting-asker); the asker's own check reads a published request that lags.
